🚤 Let's be straight with you: small boat crossings are DOWN this year. But down is not the same as fixed.

📊 23,983 people have crossed the Channel in small boats from 1 January to 19 November.
📉 That's 39% fewer than the 39,292 at the same point last year.
⚠️ But on Saturday 14 November alone, 454 people arrived in just eight boats, almost 57 per boat.
🌊 That came straight after four days with no crossings. When the weather allows, the boats come.

Nearly 24,000 illegal arrivals in under eleven months would once have been called a national emergency.

Reform UK: detain and remove illegal arrivals, end the hotels, leave the ECHR, and make it clear that crossing illegally never leads to settlement.

Read the full piece 👇
